evals.prompt: Resolve gate plan.approved in hitl mode with options approve, request-changes, abort.
evals.expected_output: Short-circuits to a user question in hitl mode, maps the selected option into the canonical verdict shape, and logs the decision.

assertions.name: hitl-short-circuit
assertions.description: The response asks the user instead of dispatching a subagent in hitl mode.

assertions.name: canonical-verdict
assertions.description: The response returns decision, rationale, follow_ups, confidence, and verdict source.

evals.prompt: Resolve an autonomous spec.approved gate with low-risk fast_path context.
evals.expected_output: Uses the fast-path approval when risk is low, returns approve with high confidence, and does not dispatch a subagent.

assertions.name: fast-path-approval
assertions.description: The response approves from context.fast_path when allowed.

assertions.name: no-unneeded-subagent
assertions.description: The response avoids subagent dispatch for a valid fast path.

evals.prompt: Resolve gate_id unknown.custom.gate in autonomous mode.
evals.expected_output: Does not silently invent a gate mapping. Escalates or reports unsupported gate type with a clear failure.

assertions.name: unknown-gate-rejected
assertions.description: The response does not dispatch an arbitrary subagent for an unknown gate.

assertions.name: clear-error
assertions.description: The response explains that the gate id is unsupported.

evals.prompt: Resolve gate plan.approved in hitl mode with context.fast_path.approve=true and options approve, request-changes, abort.
evals.expected_output: Ignores the autonomous fast-path hint because the gate is in HITL mode, asks the user via AskUserQuestion or an equivalent user prompt, and returns the selected option in the canonical verdict shape.

assertions.name: hitl-never-fast-paths
assertions.description: The response never uses fast-path approval when mode is hitl.

assertions.name: hitl-asks-user
assertions.description: The response asks the user instead of resolving the approval from context.

evals.prompt: Resolve gate spec.approved in hitl mode with spec ArtifactRefs, risk_flags=[], context.fast_path.reason='low risk', and options approve, request-changes, abort.
evals.expected_output: Asks the user to approve or reject the spec in HITL mode, ignores the fast-path hint, records source hitl, and writes the prior context to decisions.jsonl and events.jsonl.

assertions.name: spec-hitl-asks-user
assertions.description: The response prompts the user for the spec approval decision.

assertions.name: spec-hitl-source
assertions.description: The response records the verdict source as hitl instead of deterministic, fast-path, or subagent.

assertions.name: spec-hitl-audits-context
assertions.description: The response includes the prior gate context in both decisions.jsonl and events.jsonl audit entries.

evals.prompt: Resolve gate plan.approved in hitl mode with plan ArtifactRefs, context.fast_path.reason='small plan auto-approve', and options approve, request-changes, abort.
evals.expected_output: Asks the user for the plan approval decision in HITL mode, does not auto-approve from the fast-path hint, records source hitl, and writes the prior context to decisions.jsonl and events.jsonl.

assertions.name: plan-hitl-asks-user
assertions.description: The response prompts the user for the plan approval decision.

assertions.name: plan-hitl-no-auto-approval
assertions.description: The response does not approve the plan through deterministic, fast-path, or subagent resolution.

assertions.name: plan-hitl-audits-context
assertions.description: The response includes the prior gate context in both decisions.jsonl and events.jsonl audit entries.
